hooks.command: jq -c '.tool_input.query as $q | ($q // "") as $qs | ($qs | test("^\\s*(SELECT|WITH)\\b"; "i")) as $startsRead | ($qs | test("\\b(INSERT|UPDATE|DELETE|DROP|ALTER|TRUNCATE|CREATE|GRANT|REVOKE|COPY|VACUUM|REINDEX|CALL|MERGE|REFRESH\\s+MATERIALIZED|LOCK|EXECUTE|SET)\\b"; "i")) as $hasWrite | if $startsRead and ($hasWrite | not) then {hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse", permissionDecision:"allow", permissionDecisionReason:"read-only SELECT/WITH query, no write keywords detected"}} else {hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse", permissionDecision:"ask", permissionDecisionReason:"query is not a plain read-only SELECT - confirm before running"}} end'
